meta.hog_period: Jul 2025-Jun 2026, moved by AAFC hog slaughter to 2026-11-14

price_elasticity.label: Price elasticity
price_elasticity.why: an assumption; no published Canadian estimate

alpha.label: Availability elasticity
alpha.why: an assumption; no published Canadian estimate

hay_rate.label: Grain per t of hay short
hay_rate.why: straw covers it all, to grain replacing all of the hay's energy

durum_share.label: Durum share of western wheat feed
durum_share.why: middle half of the years' western production shares

feedlot_wheat_sigma.label: Western feedlot wheat price elasticity
feedlot_wheat_sigma.why: an assumption: from the general elasticity to twice the base

days_on_feed_west.label: Western feedlot grain per fed animal, as days on feed
days_on_feed_west.why: 172 days from StatCan's cattle-on-feed inventories (low) to 240, the days that give the National Beef Sustainability Assessment's 2021 rations, 2.28 t of grain per western fed animal against the model's 1.82 t (high); the Alberta beef life cycle study's 2010 rations (1.83 t) sit near the base

west_cow_grain.label: Western beef cow grain, t a head
west_cow_grain.why: 22 kg (National Beef Sustainability Assessment, 2021 western cow ration) to 184 kg (Manitoba's 2027 silage-ration guide) for every western cow; base the 1999 provincial rates Manitoba 142, Saskatchewan 97, Alberta 197, British Columbia 31 kg

west_bull_grain.label: Western bull grain, t a head
west_bull_grain.why: 32 kg (National Beef Sustainability Assessment, 2021 western bull ration) to the base, 381 kg (Manitoba's 2027 guides)
